name: Prelinker
description: Configurable preload and preconnect resource hints, delivered as Link response headers or <link> elements in the head.
project_description:
Prelinker provides a simple way to add preconnect and preload resource hints, delivered either as a Link response header (early over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3) or via a <link> element in the <head> section of the HTML.

A preconnect hint tells the browser that a domain will be required for page resources and that it should begin connecting to that server (DNS, TCP, TLS) in preparation for downloading those resources. A preload hint tells the browser (or, as a Link header, an intermediary) to fetch a specific file early so it is available sooner during rendering.

Preconnect domains and preload files are each stored as their own configuration entities, so they are listable, exportable, individually editable, and drag-orderable by weight. Each entry supports Drupal's condition (visibility) plugin system, so a hint can be limited by request path, content type, language, theme, role, and any other condition plugin -- for example, preloading a hero image only on the front page.

Beyond the manually configured entities, Prelinker can scan the rendered HTML and lift resource hints into Link headers automatically: images marked with data-preload-image attributes, existing <link rel="preload"> / <link rel="preconnect"> tags, stylesheet <link>s, and CSS @import URLs.

Release 3.x is a major release: Drupal 11 only (drops Drupal 10), adds visibility conditions on preload/preconnect entities, and adds the fetchpriority attribute (high, low, auto) on preload link elements.
